behavior: Preflight verifies actual encrypted bundle/account/target while the repository remains locked.
Readonly transaction counts all sealed rows; snapshot, orphan archive and unknown rows all block recovery.
Typed occupied-destination errors distinguish successful file verification with blocked recovery from incorrect phrase/altered file and invalid format/target.
Occupied and genuinely empty authenticated-browser checks preserve records; empty result is advisory, not recovery authorization.
No unlock, seed, overwrite, retry or recovery occurs through the new preflight controls.
